systems.system: integrated digital platform for managing health institutions and services (proposed)
systems.country_label: منصة رقمية متكاملة لتسيير المؤسسات والخدمات الصحية
systems.owner: Ministry of Health, on World Bank experts' proposal
systems.tiers: Proposed for hospitals, health centres and health posts; not deployed

note: On 9 March 2026 a World Bank mission proposed to the Ministry of Health an integrated digital platform to manage health institutions and services at hospitals, centres and posts, and the centralisation of health data; the minister said implementation would begin and a joint technical committee be formed. The platform is a proposal described only as management of institutions and services, with no statement that it carries routine aggregate reporting or the clinical record, so it is unclassified and gives no fact.
